name: Call Summary
summary: Turn any call into a summary PDF to share: robust notes, decisions, action items with owners and the shared screens. Ask Claude to change it in your own words, then save it and send it yourself

settings.label: Save PDFs in
settings.help: The folder the PDFs go to; when you save, you pick one of its subfolders or make one. Echo lets a plugin write only inside its own folder, so link yours once: Settings → Call Summary shows the Terminal command. Empty: the plugin's own folder.

settings.label: Your name
settings.help: Shown as "Prepared by" on the PDF and used to sign the email text, for example Alex Morgan. Empty: the name from the call.
